snippet.title: Alvin and the DEATHMUNKS Full game & Ending Playthrough Gameplay
snippet.description:
Warning this game contains loud noises & jumpscares!!!

You must save the world from the evil chipmunks. They killed everybody in the house and must be stopped from broadcasting their EVIL TUNES. 

Take away their microphones and escape with your life, otherwise the chipmunks will continue to brainwash their billions of adoring fans. if you can beat this game you'll be a hero!
